data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

**Purpose \& Overall Relevance for the Organization:**
 As RVP of Professional Services for Emerging Markets (middles east and Africa), you will be the most senior technical leader responsible for building, scaling, and driving the performance of DataRobot’s Professional Services organization, overseeing both the Forward Deployed Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams. You will own the end\-to\-end technical delivery lifecycle—from scoping and pitching professional services engagements to ensuring high\-quality delivery and production\-grade operationalization—while maintaining P\&L responsibility for the region.

 Commercial Strategy \& P\&L Ownership

 Professional Services Team Leadership \& Scaling
   

  

  

* Lead, scale, and develop the Professional Services organization, overseeing both the Forward Deployed Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams across MEA.

* Recruit, assess, and develop high\-performing technical talent, implementing performance management frameworks to recognize excellence and address underperformance.


 Delivery Excellence \& Operational Rigor

* Define and enforce technical standards and MLOps best practices for customer deployments, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and maintainable at enterprise scale.

 Executive Engagement \& Alignment

 You will serve as the critical bridge between global strategy and regional execution. You will partner closely with Sales, marketing, and R\&D to align technical delivery capacity with revenue growth objectives across MEA, while instilling a culture of engineering excellence, operational rigor, and customer\-centricity within your team.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** 
 :
   

  

 Technical Expertise

* Proven ability to design and oversee deployment architectures for complex, regulated enterprise environments including financial services, healthcare, and government sectors common to the MEA region.
* Familiarity with Generative AI and Agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) and their deployment considerations is a strong advantage.


 Leadership \& Management
   

  

  

* Demonstrated experience (minimum 3–5 years) leading and scaling regional or global deployment, solutions, or platform engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development across distributed geographies.
* Strong ability to manage a matrixed organization with both direct and dotted reporting lines across time zones.
* Exceptional executive\-level communication skills — able to translate technical complexity into clear business outcomes for C\-level audiences.


 Commercial Acumen
   

  

  

* Strong understanding of the commercial dynamics of a post\-sales technical function, including utilization management, delivery efficiency, and the relationship between technical success and revenue retention and expansion.


**Requisite Education and Experience / Minimum Qualifications:**
**Experience**
* 10–14 years of progressive experience in software engineering, platform deployment, or AI/ML technical roles, with a minimum of 4 years in a senior management or VP\-level leadership position.


 Education

 Cloud Experience
   

  

  

* Expert\-level, hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform including enterprise security, networking, and compliance considerations.


 Regional Experience
   

  

  

* Demonstrated experience working across the MEA region, with an appreciation for the cultural, regulatory, and commercial diversity of key markets including GCC and Europe

**Deliveroo: A DoorDash Company:** 
 Deliveroo’s mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders. Following our successful 2025 merger with DoorDash, we have solidified our position as the global leader in local commerce. This partnership has expanded our footprint to over 45 markets and gives us access to industry\-leading technology and resources. It is a defining moment for our New Verticals business, specifically our 1P delivery\-only sites, Editions and HOP. We are no longer just a delivery app; we are building the infrastructure for the future of instant retail. There has never been a more exciting time to join the 'Roo family' as we integrate with the DoorDash ecosystem to redefine what is possible in the UAE and beyond.
   

  

**New Verticals \& Site Operations:** 
 As part of the DoorDash group, our New Verticals team is the primary global engine for testing and scaling the next generation of first party (1P) retail and automated logistics. We don't just facilitate orders; we own the sites that make them happen. While others act as simple aggregators, we own the infrastructure and the operations to ensure a premium, hyper\-fast experience.
   

  

* Deliveroo Editions: The world's first delivery\-only kitchens. We provide the specialised infrastructure and operational expertise that allow our restaurant partners to scale instantly.
* Deliveroo HOP: Our 1P speedy grocery service. We own the inventory, the technology, and the end\-to\-end fulfilment process to deliver groceries in as little as 15 minutes.


**The Role:** 
 The Regional Manager oversees the end\-to\-end operations of our proprietary, 1P delivery\-only sites across the UAE, spanning both our restaurant (Editions) and retail (HOP) verticals. This is a high\-impact leadership role that balances "boots\-on\-the\-ground" operational rigour with mid\-to\-long\-term strategic decision\-making. As the primary owner of these sites, you will be responsible for all of 1P success: Uncompromised safety, perfect stock integrity, and lightning\-fast throughput.
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Excellence**
 You will drive the business forward by optimising productivity, achieving site personnel cost targets, and minimising wastage/shrinkage. You must be a "Total Ownership" leader; comfortable working strategically to enhance our operating model within the global DoorDash ecosystem while fostering a positive, collaborative, and high\-performance culture for all site colleagues. Below are the 3 key areas this role is expected to manage:
   

  

* Site Governance: Set the "drumbeat" for the region by driving KPIs and supervising compliance with Standard Operating Procedures through impactful coaching.
* Site Presence: Maintain a constant physical presence at sites to ensure a "founder’s mindset" regarding cleanliness, efficiency, and quality.
* Safety \& Compliance: Act as the lead for regional regulatory relationships, ensuring 100% compliance with Dubai Municipality (DM), ADAFSA, etc.


**Financial \& Data Stewardship**
* P\&L Management: Manage the operational lines of the P\&L, tightly controlling labor and OpEx while minimising all forms of wastage/shrinkage.
* WBR/MBR Reporting: Host and participate in Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews. You will produce high\-quality, data\-driven written inputs that articulate regional performance and clear bridges with action plans.


**People \& Strategy**
* Team Development: Recruit, onboard, and mentor a high\-performing Area Manager team, managing the full organisational life cycle from talent development to HR/ER cases.
* Stakeholder Management: Own and champion relationships with host brand partners, site owners, and senior leadership within the wider DoorDash/Deliveroo business.
* Innovation: Lead projects and pilots aimed at testing the next generation of 1P retail and automated logistics.


**Requirements**
* Industry Leadership: Minimum of 3–4 years of F\&B, FMCG, or Grocery experience, with a proven track record in Area or Regional Management.
* Operational Ownership: While direct experience in a 1P environment is a significant advantage, it is essential you demonstrate a "Total Ownership" mindset. This means you are comfortable being the final point of accountability for site standards, stock accuracy, and the seamless hand\-off from inbound receiving to last\-mile dispatch.
* Rigorous Cost Control: Expert at managing and influencing the P\&L with a focus on operational expenditure. You possess the ability to identify inefficiencies and manage labor\-to\-order ratios effectively.
* Strong Writing \& Communication: Ability to craft concise, insightful narratives for WBR and MBR reports, translating raw data into "the why" and "the how" for senior leadership.
* Analytical \& Tech\-Savvy: Data\-driven decision\-maker with a high comfort level in numbers.
* Adaptability \& Autonomy: The grit to define how your role is best achieved in a fast\-paced, evolving environment with high levels of autonomy.
* People Leadership: Excellent ability to influence senior stakeholders while motivating a multi\-national, diverse site\-level workforce.
* Project Management: Capability to lead complex, cross\-functional projects from conception to completion.


**UAE Regulatory Knowledge (Preferred):** 
 Familiarity with navigating inspections and compliance requirements for DM, ADAFSA, and Civil Defence.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary** 




 The Senior Technical Project Manager for Renewables and Batteries will provide and coordinate technical and engineering input into the identification, due diligence, development, and delivery of utility scale renewable energy projects (wind, solar, BESS and hybrid) in feasibility stage, development stage, and tender/bid stage. These technical and engineering inputs will include technology selection, balance of plant design, grid connection works, development of technical documentation to support procurement activities, and overview of installation, construction, commissioning, testing of works, warranty and operational support of existing and new projects.
 



  





  





**Reporting** 




 The Senior Technical Project Manager Renewables will be part of the Engineering and Technical Support (ETS) team for Renewables and Batteries within the GCC and will report to the Head of Engineering MENA.
 



  





  





**Key Accountabilities** 




 • Manage and coordinate engineering work packages with respect to choice of technologies, technical configurations and for setting relevant performance, statutory, safety and quality requirements.
 



 • In charge of all aspects and documentation of the contractual negotiations during Business Development of all O\&M and/or Technical\-related agreements: EPC, EPCM, PPA, OE, LTSA, etc.
 



 • Work closely with the procurement and construction team in line with the procurement strategies and construction strategies.
 



 • Be responsible for drafting/contributing to and negotiating owner specifications, including the incorporation of the latest group experience and standards.
 



 • Prepare Capex and O\&M budgets integrating feedback from Group assets and Group specialists.
 



 • Prepare all O\&M technical related documents for the bid (OM organization chart, O\&M references, O\&M Philosophy, etc.).
 



 • Interface with Lender's Engineer and support Lenders’ due diligence during closing process.
 



 • Management of internal approval process (O\&M and Technical).
 



 • Support of CEO and Construction Managers of Project Companies or CEO and Plant Managers of O\&M Companies, for punctual problems during construction, commissioning phase and during operations.
 



 • Perform technology watch and share knowledge within the ETS team
 



  





  





**Degree / Experience** 




 • Degree in an engineering discipline, bachelors or masters
 



 • Minimum of 15 years of experience in the power generation sector with specific knowledge, expertise and experience in developing or constructing solar PV and/or BESS projects including the ability to:
 



 o evaluate and perform feasibility studies
 



 o conduct technology configurations
 



 o determine construction strategies and operating philosophies
 



 o evaluate yield assessments and conceptual designs
 



 o perform techno\-economic cost analyses for the full lifecycle of a project
 



 o draft, review and negotiate commercial and contractual agreements
 



 o manage and advise transversally on all technical aspects of a project from cradle to grave
 



 • Minimum 10 years of experience in a project management or technical coordination function on solar PV or BESS development or construction projects. Formal training in project management is strongly desirable;
 



 • Knowledge in other renewable technologies such as Wind would be advantageous.
 



 • Knowledge in procurement (e.g. FIDIC) and handling multidisciplinary projects are considered strong assets;
 



 • A basic understanding of HV/MV/LV electrical systems, including international practices on grid connection for centralized energy projects, as well as electrical system integration \& optimization for industrial customers.
 



 • Knowledge and experience working on competitive tenders in the Middle East would be advantageous.
 



  





  





**Behavioral Competencies** 




 • Strong people management skills;
 



 • Flexible, meticulous, good planner, and organizer.
 



 • Ability to work autonomously and be proactive.
 



 • Stress resistant, results\-focused, determined, decisive;
 



 • You think outside the box and dare to challenge the status quo;
 



  





  





**Business Understanding** 




 • Participation on and closing of several utility scale renewable energy projects.
 



 • Development and activities internationally and in MENA in particular.
 



 • Interfaces with Business Development (BD) / Legal / Procurement / Acquisitions, Investments \& Financial Advisory (AIFA) / Construction / Operations.
 



 • O\&M and/or construction knowledge
 



  





  





**Location/travel** 




 Dubai Office with travel in GCC plus episodic travels inside and outside the MENA region.
 



 • Flexibility to travel in the AMEA region if needed.

**Role Purpose** 

 Document Controllers are responsible for the timely, accurate and efficient preparation and management of documents in our Document Control System. Ensuring the efficient organisation, numbering, sorting, filing, storing and retrieval of both electronic and hard copy documents produced by technical teams, projects or departments for our projects.
 



 To be successful in this role you should demonstrate time management skills, prioritisation and planning and organisation, with the ability to develop and maintain highly effective relationships, externally and internally.
 


**Key Accountabilities** 
* Responsible for overall coordination of controlled documentation within the Project(s) assigned.
* Perform Document Control function within validated Master Control system.
* Investigate and respond to corrective actions related to Document Control.
* Receive, direct and relay telephone calls and fax messages to Project Director.
* Receive, send, and prepare documents and ensure documents are complete and comprehensive in Transmittals while maintaining proper registers and filing.
* Prepare letters, internal and external memos, and documents including Transmittals Clearance, CVI, RFI, O\&M, Asset Register, etc.
* Ensure and verify all outgoing documents in transmittals are composed properly and accurately.
* Maintain accurate record of receipt and issue of transmittals.
* Maintain records of project documents in hard copies and electronic files as per project filing.
* Manage correspondence through MS Outlook and ACONEX.
* Arrange weekly MEP Reports.
* Handle all incoming and outgoing mails, correspondence and filling of records.
* Process leave applications and update daily manpower attendance; submit to timekeeper.
* Prepare Petty Cash Summary and payment certificates.
* Maintain general filing system and file all correspondence.
* Assist in planning and preparing meetings and conferences.
* Update logs on a daily basis.
* Compile project documents as per approved completion plan for handovers to clients.
* Ensure proper coordination with other site offices and subcontractors.
* Ensure strict adherence of HSE policies and procedures set
* Report HSE incidents/violations etc. to superiors on time
* Strict adherence of legal requirementsDrive innovation and encourage continuous improvement and cost\-effective solutions without compromising quality.


**Qualifications, Experience, Knowledge \& Skills** 
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration or other related field.
* 3\+ years experience working experience (preferred construction site experience)
* Should have the ability to operate individually and under supervision
* Ability to develop and maintain highly effective relationships, externally and internally
* Solid sense of confidentiality and discretion.
* Outstanding interpersonal, written, and communication skills.
* Ability to organize work effectively and prioritize with high attention to detail.
* Excellent PC skills including MS Office products
* Flexibility in order to adapt to varying and changing demands.

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****
* 15–18\+ years of relevant experience in Protection, Automation, Panel, or System Integration Engineering.
* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

* Engineering Tools
+ EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical
+ DIGSI, AcSELerator, EnerVista
+ ETAP / SKM

* Commercial Acumen
+ Strong understanding of technical specifications, BOM costing, value engineering, and project lifecycle

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
**Role Summary**
 The Customer Service Manager (CSM) is responsible for the day\-to\-day performance and stability of customer service operations in a fast\-paced fintech environment. This role requires a hands\-on, data\-driven leader with experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, capable of translating operational data into actionable insights. The CSM will drive service performance through queue management, capacity planning, root cause analysis (RCA), and Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, while working closely with internal teams and outsourced partners to deliver consistent, compliant, and high\-quality customer outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Insights (CSM Level)**
* Analyse customer service performance metrics including SLA, FCR, CSAT, NPS, AHT, backlog, abandonment, and repeat contacts
* Identify trends and drivers behind performance movements and translate them into clear operational actions
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for key issue types (e.g. remittance status checks, escalations, repeat contacts)
* Own and contribute to Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, highlighting recurring customer pain points and improvement opportunities
* Provide structured, insight\-led updates to the Head of Customer Service and senior stakeholders.


**Operational Service Delivery**
* Manage day\-to\-day customer service operations across voice, tickets, email, and in\-app support channels
* Oversee high\-volume call centre operations, ensuring queue health, responsiveness, and service stability
* Monitor ticket backlogs, ageing, and abandonment rates, taking corrective action where required
* Manage escalations, including coordination with internal teams and third\-party partners
* Lead and participate in daily stand\-ups to track performance, risks, and priorities


**Capacity Planning \& Workforce Management**
* Track service demand versus available capacity by channel and product
* Identify capacity gaps and support short\-term and medium\-term workforce planning
* Monitor agent productivity, utilisation, and adherence
* Support SLA and KPI discussions with outsourced partners using data\-backed insights


**CRM \& Process Discipline**
* Ensure consistent and accurate use of the CRM, including: a) Ticket logging and categorisation b) Status updates and escalation handling c) Routing and workflow adherence
* Maintain strong data hygiene to support reliable reporting and analysis
* Identify process inefficiencies or system gaps based on hands\-on operational experience


**People Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Provide hands\-on coaching and real\-time guidance to agents and team leads
* Reinforce service quality standards, communication best practices, and escalation protocols
* Act as a first point of support for complex or sensitive customer cases
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus


**Requirements**
* Proven experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, ideally within fintech, banking, or financial services
* Strong data and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance metrics and drive actions
* Hands\-on experience with CRM systems (ticketing, routing, reporting)
* Experience leading RCA and VoC analysis to drive service and process improvements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including collaboration with Product, Tech, Risk, and outsourced partners.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, regulated environment Desirable.
* Experience working with outsourced BPO partners.
* Exposure to fintech products such as payments, wallets, lending, or merchant services.
* Understanding of regulatory and compliance considerations in customer service operations. Success Measures
* Improved SLA, FCR, CSAT, and abandonment performance
* Reduced backlog and ageing tickets.
* Clear, actionable RCA and VoC insights influencing operational improvements.
* Stable and predictable day\-to\-day service delivery.
* Improved agent productivity and consistency

**About Us** 




 This marketing agency is hiring a commercially minded, hands\-on Media Strategist to own and scale paid campaigns across Google and Meta, while supporting expansion into new platforms.

 This is a delivery\-focused role with clear commercial performance expectations — not a coordination position.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Owns paid media strategy and execution for assigned products
* Builds, launches, and scales campaigns across Google Ads and Meta
* Manages performance against clear CPA, ROAS, and margin targets
* Monitors campaigns daily and makes decisive optimisation changes
* Tests new creative approaches, audiences, bidding models, and landing page strategies
* Develops and iterates ad copy across Google and Meta, including RSA headline and description variants, Meta primary text and CTAs, and landing page messaging

* Contributes to expansion into new platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Native, and Programmatic where commercially justified

* Provides structured and concise performance reporting to the Head of Media



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Has 3–7 years of experience managing paid media campaigns, with strong hands\-on expertise in Google Ads and Meta (5\+ years preferred)
* Demonstrates proven experience running lead generation campaigns with clear commercial accountability
* Has a strong track record of working against strict CPA and performance targets
* Possesses strong analytical capability and is comfortable working with performance data on a daily basis
* Demonstrates strong commercial awareness, with a clear understanding that success is measured by profitability and scalability rather than traffic alone
* Brings experience across additional platforms such as Bing, YouTube, Native, TikTok, and similar channels, which is considered advantageous
* Has experience marketing within regulated sectors such as financial services, insurance, legal, or healthcare; familiarity with FCA advertising standards or equivalent is highly advantageous
* Actively uses generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent platforms as part of daily workflow, including copy generation, creative briefing, performance analysis, and reporting
* Demonstrates exceptional written and spoken English fluency at a business and client\-ready level
* Has experience marketing products within the UK or other native English\-speaking markets, which is considered highly advantageous
* Exhibits a high\-ownership mentality and thrives in a results\-driven environment
* Is most likely currently based in Dubai, although exceptional candidates requiring relocation support may also be considered



  





**What the company offers:** 



* Offers a competitive salary alongside a monthly performance\-based bonus structure typically valued at approximately 15% of gross salary
* Provides clear performance accountability with strong opportunities for career progression
* Enables direct involvement in strategic decision\-making across multiple verticals, supported by a short reporting line and genuine commercial ownership of accounts from day one
* Presents a high\-impact, high\-autonomy role within a growing media team
* Supports a flexible working culture, including remote working where appropriate
* Offers the opportunity to work within a business actively investing in innovation and AI\-enabled marketing

data.jd_text:
**Head of Category \& Merchandising** 




  





 About the Role
 



  





 Fynde has partnered with a global cross\-border eCommerce platform that specialises in bringing international products to customers across the Middle East and wider international markets. With a strong presence across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, the business simplifies access to millions of global products by managing sourcing, import logistics, and last\-mile delivery through a seamless, consumer\-first digital experience.
 



  





 We are now headhunting a Head of Category \& Merchandising to take strategic and commercial ownership of category performance across the platform, with an initial focus on Health \& Supplements alongside broader involvement across multiple product categories within the organisation.
 



  





 Based in Dubai, this is a commercially driven leadership role focused on category growth, merchandising strategy, localisation, digital trading performance, and customer engagement across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. The position blends category management, product selection, pricing, ecommerce merchandising, analytics, and AI\-enabled optimisation, requiring someone capable of shaping both strategic direction and operational execution within a fast\-paced cross\-border ecommerce environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Category \& Commercial Ownership** 




 Lead the strategy, development, and ongoing performance management of key product categories across the platform, with a particular focus on Health \& Supplements. Drive revenue growth, margin optimisation, customer engagement, and category expansion in alignment with wider business objectives across multiple international markets.
 



  





**Assortment Development \& Curation** 




 Build commercially relevant and scalable product assortments based on customer behaviour, market trends, data analysis, and commercial opportunity. Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen category depth, introduce new products, and optimise the product mix across both regional and international audiences.
 



  





**Product Performance \& Trading Analysis** 




 Use dashboards, sales reporting, customer insights, and trading data to evaluate category performance and identify opportunities for optimisation. Analyse SKU performance, pricing effectiveness, conversion trends, promotional impact, and customer demand to drive commercial decision\-making.
 



  





**Pricing \& Promotional Strategy** 




 Develop and optimise pricing strategies in line with consumer expectations, competitive positioning, and margin objectives. Plan and execute promotional activity to support seasonal campaigns, category growth initiatives, and overall trading performance.
 



  





**Regional \& International Localisation** 




 Support the localisation and optimisation of category content, product presentation, and customer experience across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. Ensure merchandising strategies align with local consumer behaviours, cultural nuances, and evolving market expectations.
 



  





**AI \& Merchandising Automation** 




 Partner with data and technology teams to leverage AI, automation, and merchandising tools to improve category performance. Contribute towards initiatives involving product recommendations, dynamic pricing, search optimisation, inventory visibility, and broader ecommerce automation strategies.
 



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 Work closely with marketing, operations, supply chain, customer experience, and technology teams to ensure strong execution of category plans and alignment across all customer touchpoints.
 



  





**Market Intelligence \& Competitor Benchmarking** 




 Monitor developments across ecommerce, health \& wellness, consumer behaviour, and digital merchandising trends. Benchmark competitor activity, assortment strategy, pricing structures, and promotional campaigns to identify commercial opportunities and areas for improvement.
 



  





**Lifecycle \& Inventory Management** 




 Oversee the full lifecycle management of SKUs, ensuring products remain commercially viable, available, and aligned with category strategy. Collaborate with supply chain and operations teams to support forecasting, replenishment, and inventory optimisation.
 



 Requirements
 



  




* 5\+ years of experience within ecommerce category management, digital merchandising, ecommerce trading, or related commercial functions.
* Strong experience within Health, Supplements, Wellness, FMCG, Consumer Goods, or adjacent ecommerce\-led categories.
* Proven commercial acumen with responsibility for revenue growth, margin optimisation, product mix, and trading performance.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insight into commercial action.
* Experience working alongside AI\-enabled merchandising tools, pricing engines, ecommerce CMS platforms, or automation technologies.
* Understanding of cross\-border ecommerce operations, digital marketplaces, and international trading environments.
* Experience operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, or wider Middle Eastern markets would be highly advantageous.
* Arabic language capabilities would be highly advantageous.
* Entrepreneurial, proactive, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to build, shape, and improve processes within a growing organisation.
* Ability to operate both strategically and hands\-on within a fast\-moving ecommerce environment.

AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)

data.jd_text:
The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East. This is a key role within the Middle East team. The successful candidate will bring substantial EA experience, gained within an international Law Firm(s) based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9 00am to 6 00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
   

  




  


  

  

 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
   

  

 Please note that, as part of the recruitment process, successful shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete Numeracy, Comprehension and Prioritisation assessments, which will take approximately 60 minutes in total.
   

  




  


**Please apply directly through with your application and kindly only contact our Recruitment team for any further details, legal experiance is essential part of the criteria for this role.**
  

  
   

  




  


 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Executive support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This may include but is not limited to the following
   

  

 •Proactively manage the Head of Middle East’s complex and high‑volume diary, including scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, often involving numerous senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
   

  

 •Act as a gatekeeper for the Head of Middle East, triaging meeting requests, queries, issues and complaints, redirecting appropriately while ensuring matters are dealt with effectively and without unnecessary involvement from the Head.
   

  

 •Prepare agendas, attend meetings where the Head of Middle East is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and proactively follow up with action owners to ensure completion within agreed timeframes.
   

  

 •Attend additional meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head of Middle East where appropriate, independently managing follow‑up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East with strategic and commercial decision‑making by proactively preparing briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to ensure decisions are well‑informed.
   

  

 •Anticipate information requirements and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams to ensure relevant input is available in advance of key meetings or decisions.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation
   

  

 •Arrange end‑to‑end complex travel for the Head of Middle East, including multi‑destination international itineraries, coordination of different modes of transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
   

  

 •Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction‑specific requirements.
   

  

 •Provide strategic input into travel planning, designing trips that maximise effectiveness by combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
   

  

 •Liaise extensively with colleagues across offices and business functions to ensure a joined‑up firm approach and maximise the value of each trip.
   

  

 •Remain flexible and responsive, managing last‑minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently when required.
   

  

 •Prepare detailed post‑trip reports summarising meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities identified and agreed next steps, for circulation to relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 •Ensure all follow‑up meetings and actions arising from travel are diarised promptly, tracked and progressed to completion.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Marketing / Business Development Support
   

  

 •Manage speaking engagements and thought‑leadership commitments, including tracking article and submission deadlines, coordinating preparatory research, and drafting briefing materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
   

  

 •Arrange and coordinate preparatory and briefing meetings in advance of panels, speaking slots or publications, ensuring the Head of Middle East is fully prepared.
   

  

 •Liaise with the Knowledge team and other internal stakeholders to obtain research support and background material where required, to ensure contributions are accurate, relevant and high quality.
   

  

 •Register the Head of Middle East for events when instructed and prepare comprehensive pre‑event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives, to maximise the value of attendance.
   

  

 •Working with the Head of Middle East and Business Development teams to maintain up‑to‑date client target lists.
   

  

 •Track and maintain updates on client target status, ensuring actions and deliverables assigned to relationship partners are followed up and progressed.
   

  

 •Provide regular status updates to the Head of Middle East on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against agreed objectives.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Billing, Finance \& Expenses
   

  

 •Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head of Middle East’s matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
   

  

 •Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance as required, and issue final approved invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
   

  

 •Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of expense submissions for the Head of Middle East, including liaising directly with vendors (restaurants and transport providers etc) to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where receipts were not provided or have been misplaced.
   

  

 •Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget holder approval in line with firm policy.
   

  

 •Proactively follow up with clients regarding outstanding invoices and payments, providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East and keeping the Billing and Finance teams fully informed of progress, issues or agreed payment timelines.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Performance \& People Processes
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East throughout the performance review process, ensuring review meetings are scheduled in line with firm‑wide deadlines.
   

  

 •Prepare performance review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
   

  

 •Proactively monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
   

  

 •Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head of Middle East during discussions.
   

  

 •Support completion of post‑meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, ensuring timely and accurate submission.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of outstanding actions arising from performance reviews.
   

  

 •Maintain close and regular communication with HR throughout the performance review cycle, ensuring awareness of progress, confirming deadlines, understanding process or system changes, and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 CRM \& Relationship Management
   

  

 •Maintain and update the Head of Middle East’s contacts and relationship data in InterAction, ensuring activities, meetings and relationship notes are accurately recorded.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in managing and maintaining effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers, supporting collaboration across jurisdictions.
   

  

 •Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring referrals are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in ensuring referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow‑up on agreed actions and opportunities.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations), ensuring strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of initiatives impacting the region.
   

  

 •Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings, ensuring all Business Operations functions are kept informed, aligned and engaged on regional matters.
   

  

 •Use these forums to share relevant knowledge or developments that may impact specific functions, agree deliverables, and capture upcoming activities, deadline changes and requirements that should be on the Head of Middle East’s radar.
   

  

 •Ensure key outputs from Middle East Operations meetings are fed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings, promoting alignment and proactive planning across the region.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Person Specification
   

  

 •Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
   

  

 •Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi‑time‑zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
   

  

 •Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi‑destination itineraries, visas and short‑notice changes.
   

  

 •Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparation of draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
   

  

 •Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling review meetings, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
   

  

 •Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
   

  

 •Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
   

  

 •Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence drafting correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
   

  

 •Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
   

  

 •Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
   

  

 •Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
   

  

 •Professional, client‑focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior internal stakeholders and clients.
   

  

 •Fluent written and spoken English.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Benefits include (but are not limited to)
   

  

 •Competitive salary (negotiable depending on experience)
   

  

 •Premium international medical, dental, and optical insurance
   

  

 •30 days of annual leave
   

  

 •Employee Assistance Programme
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Competencies
   

  

 •Working together
   

  

 •Integrity and respect
   

  

 •Inclusive
   

  

 •Personal impact and growth
   

  

 •Driving high standards
   

  

 •Commercial mindset
   

  

 •Client \- centric
   

  

 •Responsible

 Type: Full\-Time

 A Dubai\-based investment firm managing a diversified portfolio across alternative strategies and select direct investments. We run a focused, research\-driven process where analytical depth and independent judgment define how capital is deployed.

 We are looking for an Investment Director to lead investment research and coordinate the end\-to\-end investment process. This is a research\-intensive, high\-autonomy position for a professional who combines deep market knowledge with operational rigor.

Identify key trends and develop scenario analyses to inform investment decisions and portfolio positioning. Distill actionable insights and periodic briefs for senior leadership.

 CFA, CAIA, or equivalent professional certifications. Additional programming skills (R, SQL, etc.). Experience with emerging markets. Proven portfolio management track record.

Thunes is scaling fast rapidly across the Middle East and we’re looking for elite hunters to open new markets and close transformational deals. If you love building, thrive on delivering big deals, and want to sell a product that actually moves money globally in real\-time, this is your opportunity!
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the end\-to\-end sales cycle \- prospect, pitch, negotiate, close, and activate
* Build and convert a high\-quality pipeline of fintechs, banks, PSPs, and digital platforms
* Open new markets, landing strategic logos and unlocking revenue fast
* Drive senior\-level conversations with founders, C\-suite, and product teams
* Collaborate with internal teams to execute seamless go\-lives and expand accounts


**What You’ll Bring**
* 8\+ years in B2B payment sales, proven hunter DNA
* Strong network across PSPs, fintechs, banks, wallets, e\-commerce players
* Track record of exceeding targets and closing complex commercial deals
* Execution\-first mindset \- proactive, resilient, self\-driven, hands\-on
* Fluent English; other regional languages welcome


**Why join Thunes**
* Uncapped commission with real earning power
* High\-growth fintech backed by global investors
* Sell a mission\-critical payments network used by world\-class brands driving financial inclusion
* Huge white\-space markets \- build and own your territory
* Culture of ownership, ambition, and entrepreneurial execution


**About Thunes**
 Thunes is the Smart Superhighway to move money around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real\-time in over 130 countries and more than 80 currencies.
   

  

 Thunes’ network connects directly to over 7 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, as well as 15 billion cards via more than 320 different payment methods, such as GCash, M\-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.
   

  

 Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in\-house SmartX Treasury System and Fortress Compliance Platform, ensuring Members of the network receive unrivaled speed, control, visibility, protection and cost efficiencies when making real\-time payments, globally.
   

  

 Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super\-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.
   

  

 Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 14 locations, including Abidjan, Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, Hong Kong, Johannesburg, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco and Shanghai.
   

  

 For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommerce with defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the Senior eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 5\+ years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Investment Director – Real Estate, Hospitality \& Tourism
 



 Dubai, United Arab Emirates
 



  





 Investment Platform / Strategic Investment Group
 



  





 A leading investment platform is seeking an experienced Investment Director to join its growing investment team, with a focus across Real Estate, Hospitality, and Tourism\-related investments.
 



  





 This position will play a key role in both portfolio management and new investment execution, working closely with senior leadership to drive value creation, operational enhancement, strategic growth initiatives, and transaction execution across a diversified portfolio.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead the oversight and strategic management of portfolio companies across real estate, hospitality, and tourism sectors
* Partner closely with executive management teams and board members to drive operational and financial performance improvements
* Assess investment opportunities, strategic acquisitions, joint ventures, and growth initiatives
* Support end\-to\-end transaction execution including origination, due diligence, structuring, negotiation, and post\-investment monitoring
* Evaluate business strategies, operational efficiencies, capital allocation initiatives, and expansion opportunities
* Monitor portfolio risk, performance metrics, and investment returns
* Work alongside external advisors, consultants, investment banks, and legal counsel on strategic initiatives and transactions

 Candidate Profile
 


* 10–15 years of experience within Private Equity, Sovereign Wealth Funds, Investment Banking, Principal Investments, or large diversified investment groups
* Strong exposure to Real Estate, Hospitality, Infrastructure, or Tourism investments
* Demonstrated experience managing investments and engaging with senior stakeholders, boards, and executive teams
* Strong financial analysis, valuation, and transaction execution capabilities
* Proven ability to identify operational and strategic value creation opportunities
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline
* MBA, CFA, ACA, ACCA, or CPA qualifications are advantageous

data.jd_text:
Shamal Holding is a diversified investment firm that cultivates the extraordinary. Born in Dubai, we curate a unique portfolio of extraordinary investments, experiences and assets to generate meaningful outcomes. The investments we make are strategically chosen and thoughtfully nurtured, mirroring Dubai’s ambition, spirit and energy. As a global investor, asset owner and developer we utilise our resources, know\-how and connections, to deliver long\-term value, wherever we operate. Our portfolio spans Lifestyle \& Entertainment, Destinations, Real Estate, Hospitality, and F\&B, including Skydive Dubai, Deep Dive Dubai, XDubai, Dubai Harbour, Kite Beach and more.
   

  

 As Shamal Holding continues to grow, we’re in search of a
 **Senior Manager \- Commercial Asset Management** 
 . In this role, you will be responsible for maximizing the value and performance of Shamal Holding’s hospitality asset portfolio. The role involves strategic oversight of hotel operators, performance monitoring, capital planning, and ensuring that the assets meet financial and operational targets. The role will also support new acquisitions, expansions and developments by providing asset\-level insights and lead execution of projects.
   

  

**Asset Performance \& Strategy**
* Lead the development and execution of asset strategies to enhance asset value and returns.
* Monitor financial and operational KPIs of the hospitality portfolio.
* Analyse monthly and quarterly performance reports from hotel operators and provide insights to leadership.
* Benchmark performance against market data and competitive set.


**Operator Management**
* Act as the key liaison between Shamal and hotel operators, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Review annual budgets, business plans, marketing plans, and capital expenditure plans.
* Ensure compliance with management agreements, brand standards, and operating covenants.


**Financial \& Investment Analysis**
* Perform financial modelling, scenario analysis, and valuation of existing and potential assets.
* Assist in the underwriting of new hospitality investments and developments.
* Work closely with finance and investment teams to support strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate and assess annual budgets and projections.


**Capital Planning \& Project Oversight**
* Oversee capital expenditure projects and renovations to ensure timelines and budgets are met.
* Support in repositioning or rebranding strategies to improve asset performance.


**Project Management and Committee approvals**
* Oversee all capital expenditure projects for approval.
* Upon approval, manage their completion to ensure adherence to the allocated budget.


**Reporting \& Governance**
* Prepare and present asset performance reports to senior management and stakeholders.
* Ensure adherence to internal governance, risk, and compliance frameworks.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as hospitality, strategy, finance, or business administration is required.
* Certification in hospitality analytics, real estate or asset management.
* 8\-10 years of experience in hospitality, F\&B, asset management, hotel consulting, investment, or related fields.
* Strong knowledge of hotel operations, P\&L analysis, contract negotiation, and operator management.


**For more information about Shamal, please visit our LinkedIn page** 
 https//www.linkedin.com/company/shamalholding/
   

  

**Note**
 Due to a high influx of profiles, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who We Are?**
 When you think of food delivery in the MENA region, we’d be pretty surprised if talabat didn’t pop into your mind first! Since delivering our first order in Kuwait in 2004, we’ve grown quite a lot over the past 17 years.
   

  

 Today, we deliver hundreds of millions of food orders, grocery items and other products per year, to our customers in nine countries throughout the region with more than 3,000\+ employees! Our food delivery business works with over 27,000 brands and almost 50,000 branches, while our q\-commerce concept, talabat mart, now delivers groceries to customers in Bahrain, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Oman Qatar, and the UAE in 30 minutes or less!
   

  

 Our philosophy is to make sure we do what is right for our ecosystem \- our customers, our partners, our people, our riders, and the communities in which we operate. Our \#techforgood program allows our customers a safe and convenient way to contribute to important causes in their community through donating to local and international charities directly on talabat with a focus on food insecurity in the region. Since its inception in 2020, we have facilitated the donation of well over 1 million meals to those in need, as well as donated over $1\.5 million to charity with the help of our partners and customers. talabat is part of Delivery Hero, the global leader in online food delivery and q\-commerce.
   

  

**Role Summary**
* Owns regional value creation, translating strategic priorities into clear commercial initiatives with measurable impact.
* Leads complex, cross\-market programs, ensuring rigorous project management, senior\-level alignment, and disciplined execution.
* Establishes scalable commercial frameworks, enabling consistent decision\-making while preserving local market flexibility.
* Drives insight\-led decisions through advanced analytics, turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Shapes executive dialogue, influencing stakeholders through structured communication and fact\-based narratives.
* Deploys technology as a performance lever, improving productivity, transparency, and speed to impact.
* Builds durable capabilities, strengthening commercial skill sets across teams and markets.
* Responsible for driving long\-term growth plans, achieving revenue and profitability targets, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure success.


**What's On Your Plate?**
* Applies a strong understanding of industry trends and internal business processes to adapt strategies to changing market conditions.
* Develops frameworks that address regional challenges by combining market insights, competitor analysis, and operational considerations.
* Leads financial and operational performance at the regional level by optimizing pricing, promotions, and product offerings.
* Drives improvements by implementing tools and practices that enhance efficiency and business outcomes.
* Builds and develops a high\-performing regional commercial team, fostering collaboration and accountability.
* Supports succession planning by mentoring senior managers and aligning team skills with business objectives.
* Partners with other functions to deliver cohesive strategies and ensure smooth cross\-departmental coordination.
* Directly influences business growth through initiatives like optimizing commercial processes, improving market penetration, and enhancing customer retention strategies.
* Provides critical support to cross\-functional teams, ensuring alignment between commercial goals and overall company objectives


**What Did We Order?**
* Problem Solving: Resolves complex business challenges by using data\-driven analysis and developing innovative solutions. Handles critical decisions such as market entry strategies, pricing adjustments, and operational improvements with a focus on sustainable results. implements processes that empower teams to identify and address challenges independently.
* Interpersonal Skills: Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including senior executives, cross\-functional leaders, and external partners, to ensure alignment on key strategies and objectives. Communicates complex business challenges and solutions effectively, tailoring the message to different audiences to gain alignment and drive informed decision\-making. Excels in influencing and persuading stakeholders to adopt strategies that drive long\-term business success, using a combination of data\-driven insights and a deep understanding of market dynamics.
