Head of Liabilities and Payments
   

  

**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking to unlock new job opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities.
   

  

 HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking aim to be the international bank of choice for affluent customers, supporting their domestic and international banking, and holistic wealth management needs. We provide a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Global Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an ambitious leader to join our International Wealth and Premier Banking team, working together with colleagues to define, manage and achieve divisional business targets.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Own Liabilities \& Payments strategy (CASA, Deposits, Payments): Define and manage product, pricing and marketing plans to meet customer needs and grow penetration/market share.
* Drive financial performance: Manage a significant balance sheet and P\&L, delivering FRP outcomes through balance growth, margin optimization, fee/interest income and payment usage.
* Optimize and evolve the product portfolio: Use market trends, customer segmentation and portfolio reviews to identify gaps/opportunities, prioritize initiatives and maintain a competitive proposition.
* Lead change and capability delivery: Provide product expertise and deliver change programs, including multi\-channel and Mobile\-led enhancements, to hit revenue and digital delivery targets.
* Improve customer journeys and experience: Streamline end\-to\-end processes, strengthen customer communications, and partner with Customer Experience teams to resolve pain points and improve satisfaction/NPS.
* Ensure governance and controls: Maintain 1st line accountability for controls, policy\-compliant product launches, and effective engagement/influence across key UAE governance forums and senior stakeholders.


**To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:**
* 
+ Minimum 10 years’ experience in transaction banking product development / sales / marketing within leading financial institutions.
+ Solid product knowledge across CASA, deposits and payments, with a proven product development track record.
+ Demonstrated ability to deliver outcomes and take responsibility for end\-to\-end commercial KPIs (balance, margin, fees, usage).
+ Experience coordinating across sales, training, IT and financial planning, and delivering multi\-function projects successfully.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer\-centric financial super\-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in KSA, UAE and Kuwait, and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, Amazon, IKEA, eXtra and Farfetch as well as small and medium businesses.
   

  

 Tamara is Saudi’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others, operating out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia with other regional and global support offices.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a startup\-within\-a\-startup role. You will be responsible for building a net new banking product from scratch for the Saudi Arabia market — from ideation through design and launch.
   

  

 This role is high ambiguity, high complexity, and requires someone who thrives in uncharted territory. There is no playbook — you will write it. You must be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making tactical trade\-offs, and moving with execution velocity.
   

  

 As Product Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle of a new fintech product that will advance how merchants at Tamara manage their money. You will work daily with a full\-stack team — engineers, product designers, researchers, data analysts, operations, and business stakeholders — to ship an innovative and incredible experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the execution, vision \& strategy for a net new fintech vertical.
* Work with engineers, designers, data scientists, and commercial teams to drive the roadmap for a net\-new product.
* Be technically competent enough to be able to decide on the execution plan while managing several internal technical dependencies.
* Deeply understand the KSA Fintech ecosystem, compliance rules \& regulations — and understand how it may impact your roadmap.
* Deeply understand the operational impacts of the products we are releasing \& work with risk, compliance, treasury, customer support and others to ensure product success.
* Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor, Claude \& Codex to accelerate product development work.
* Contribute to commercial planning \& GTM of the product and own the outcomes.
* Lead a core team of engineers \& designers and drive the end to end execution forward.
* Contribute to the evolution of Tamara’s Product Management practices as AI scales our work.


**Qualifications**
* You have 4\+ years of Product Management experience, with proven experience building 0—\>1 products that have shipped and scaled.
* You have worked with early stage product teams or startups and have successfully taken a product from concept to launch.
* You have strong UX taste — you care deeply about the end\-to\-end customer experience and can hold a high bar for product quality.
* You have experience working on complex, multi\-surface products with a large blast radius of impact.
* You are a strong collaborator who works effectively with engineering, design, data, and operations teams on a daily basis.
* You are data\-driven — you have strong analytical skills, are comfortable with experimentation, and can use data to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
* You are able to think from first principles, break down complex problems, and navigate ambiguity with confidence.
* You have strong business acumen — you understand unit economics, business models, and can make decisions that balance customer value with business outcomes.
* You understand regulatory requirements and operational considerations that come with building financial products.
* You are customer\-obsessed — you aren’t shy about getting on calls with merchants, visiting them, and deeply understanding their needs.
* FinTech experience — you have worked on financial products before and understand the nuances of payments, banking, lending, or adjacent spaces.
* Must have the ability to use AI in their day to day to work. Preferred experience working in high\-growth companies.
* Arabic speaking is required for this role — you will work closely with merchants and stakeholders in KSA.


 All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

**Company Description**
*We’re* 
*Checkout.com* 
*. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*
*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions daily for more than one billion global shoppers.*
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*
*If you want to do career\-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*
**The Role**
 Checkout.com is seeking a talented Senior Financial Partnerships Specialist in Riyadh to join the adventure and support our rapid growth and expansion in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 Working with a regional team, your main responsibility will be to manage and grow our partnerships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and card networks such as Visa, Mastercard and MADA. You will contribute to the development and execution of our strategy for such partnerships.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Financial Partnerships \- MENA, the successful candidate will be able to handle multiple projects and partnerships autonomously, have sufficient payments knowledge and experience to do so, and have a hands\-on approach necessary in a fast growing start\-up like ours. This is a great opportunity to contribute, learn and grow working on a broad range of projects in building a world\-class payments infrastructure.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Manage commercial relationships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and grow Card Networks (including MADA) to develop and deliver market leading payment solutions for our merchants.
* Drive expansion projects as required across geographies and payment methods in collaboration with a wider team.
* Negotiate the most favorable operational and commercial outcomes for Checkout.com while balancing internal and external stakeholders
* Ensure existing processes are followed and deliverables are met by both sides in a partnership. Design and develop new processes to scale those partnerships for growth, efficiency and performance improvement.
* Collaborate effectively with various functions in the partner organization such as relationship management, business development, risk, compliance, product and operations across all levels.
* Develop and execute a best\-in\-class partnership management model. Be the single point of contact internally and externally for assigned partnerships.
* Use payments industry knowledge and experience to develop and execute strategies to support our growth with new products, services and market segments through partnerships.
* Craft and implement win\-win commercial agreements and go\-to\-market strategies with payment partners.
* Leverage knowledge about the payments industry and partners’ capabilities to act as subject matter experts for internal teams.


**Qualifications**
* At least 3 years experience in payments.
* Direct experience in payment processing, acquiring, or managing payment partnerships.
* Proficient in payments knowledge, with the ability to problem solve or identify potential blockers within the payment flow and communicate these problems effectively to the wider teams.
* Experience working with card networks or PSPs for acquiring payment transactions is a strong plus.
* A mix of operations, project management, and relationship management skill set.
* A strong sense of ownership to deliver business results with a focus on managing partner relationships.
* Arabic speaking is MANDATORY for this role due to the relationships with local partners
* Strong collaborator and communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders across organizations internally and externally.
* Data\-driven, analytical and strategic in problem solving issues and identifying opportunities to drive growth and efficiency.
* Comfortable working across time zones and cultures in a globally distributed team.


**Additional Information**
**Bring all of you to work**
 We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
   

  

 Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
   

  

 We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
   

  

 It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
   

  

**Life at** 
**Checkout.com**
 We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
   

  

 Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
   

  

 For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

data.jd_text:
**The opportunity** 




 A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. This is a build\-stage organisation growing to approximately fifty people over its first two years, and it needs someone to build and run the entire corporate infrastructure from the ground up.
 



 We are hiring a Head of Corporate Services to own premises, HR, finance back\-office, corporate IT, travel, and governance administration as a single integrated function. This is not a supervisory role over a team of specialists. It is a working post: the person we are looking for remains personally involved in the work, makes the decisions, and is accountable for the outcomes regardless of whether they are delivered through direct staff or outsourced providers.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Sourcing, negotiating, and managing the Company's office lease and fit\-out; ongoing facilities management and physical security
* Payroll, benefits, leave, expense systems, and visa and immigration administration for all staff and dependants
* Drafting and enforcing the employee handbook and HR policies; compliance with Omani Labour Law and Omanisation requirements
* Selecting and managing external accountants, auditors, and tax advisors; bookkeeping, AP, AR, and cash management; establishing and managing banking relationships
* Corporate IT: end\-user devices, M365 administration, identity management, IT support, and cybersecurity for corporate systems
* Owning the corporate travel policy; managing the travel agency and duty\-of\-care arrangements for travelling staff
* Maintaining statutory records and registers; coordinating Board and committee meetings; filing statutory returns; managing the corporate insurance programme
* Maintaining the master vendor and contract register; negotiating, renewing, and terminating corporate service contracts



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 10 years in corporate services, operations, or general management roles, with at least five years at senior level. A demonstrable track record of leading a small, multi\-disciplinary corporate function, not solely managing large departments staffed by specialists. Proven experience either establishing a regulated financial entity in Oman or the GCC, or leading the corporate function of an existing regulated entity of comparable size. Working knowledge of Omani Labour Law, immigration procedures, and corporate regulations. Demonstrated capability across multiple disciplines concurrently: premises, HR, finance, IT, and governance. Fluent in Arabic and English, written and spoken.
 



 Experience in a financial market infrastructure, bank, or other regulated financial services entity is an advantage. So is familiarity with the IFC Oman regulatory framework and prior experience in a start\-up or greenfield environment.
 



  





**What this is** 




 On day one, the office does not exist, the payroll has not been run, the banking has not been established, and the IT has not been deployed. Within twelve months, all of it needs to be running to the standard of an international regulated institution. The person who takes this role will have built it. If that is the kind of challenge you are looking for, and you have the breadth of experience to deliver it, this is worth a conversation.

data.raw_snippet:

 We are hiring
data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is a greenfield central securities depository being built to go\-live in 2027\.
 



  





 We are hiring a Head of Product Technology to own the technology platform end\-to\-end: the application and the infrastructure on which it runs. This is not background plumbing. The application is the product. The infrastructure is the foundation on which settlement finality, system resilience, latency performance, and operational availability are delivered. The post\-holder must understand both layers as one integrated whole and own them as one.
 



  





 In Build, the post\-holder is the architect of the platform from a blank sheet: technology reference architecture, infrastructure topology, hosting strategy, network and database design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and disaster\-recovery architecture. In Run, the same person operates the platform and the team they have designed. This is not a sit\-in\-your\-office role.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Designing the technology reference architecture from a blank sheet: application architecture, infrastructure topology, database platform, network design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and DR architecture
* Owning the application end\-to\-end: design, configuration, integration, data model, change management, and support
* Owning the infrastructure that hosts the platform: compute, storage, network, virtualisation, database, and middleware, whether on\-premise, hosted, or cloud
* Owning platform resilience: high availability design, backup and recovery architecture, disaster recovery, business continuity, and tested failover
* Owning end\-to\-end platform performance including transaction latency, capacity planning, and headroom strategy
* Owning first\-line platform security: secure configuration, hardening, identity and access management, vulnerability management, patching, and security incident response
* Owning the technical relationship with the build vendor; holding them to account on functional, technical, and operational delivery
* Designing the human operating model for the platform: team shape, shift patterns, on\-call rotations, incident command structure, runbooks, and third\-party support arrangements
* Owning all integrations between the platform and external systems: custodians, settlement banks, exchange, SWIFT, Bloomberg, and ISIN infrastructure
* Line managing the Application Managers, Database Administrator, and the wider platform engineering team as it builds



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 12 years in financial\-services platform technology, with substantial time spent owning a mission\-critical platform end\-to\-end across both application and infrastructure layers. Direct, demonstrable experience architecting a mission\-critical regulated financial platform from a blank sheet: this is non\-negotiable. Direct, demonstrable experience as the technical authority on a CSD, custody platform, post\-trade platform, capital markets platform, or core banking system of comparable mission\-criticality: also non\-negotiable.
 



  





 Hands\-on technical credibility across both application and infrastructure layers: able to read code, query a database, design a network topology, debug an integration, and challenge a vendor's technical decisions with authority. Demonstrated experience holding a major build vendor or system integrator to account on technical delivery. Deep understanding of how a regulated financial\-services business works, not just the technology underneath it. Fluent in English.
 



  





 Experience in financial market infrastructure (CSD, CCP, exchange, or payment system) is an advantage. So is familiarity with CPMI\-IOSCO principles and experience designing SWIFT, Bloomberg, and ICSD integrations.
 



  





**What this is** 




 The platform does not exist yet. The architecture has not been designed, the infrastructure has not been built, and the operating model has not been written. The person who takes this role will have done all of it. If you have genuinely architected and owned a mission\-critical regulated financial platform from a blank sheet, and you have the hands\-on credibility and delivery drive to do it again, this is worth a conversation.

The intention is that the post\-holder progresses into the Head of Risk and Compliance role in the Run phase.
 



  





 The first\-line functions own the day\-to\-day execution and the controls that surround it. The Regulatory and Risk Lead independently reviews, challenges, and reports on that first\-line execution; sets the policy and framework standards within which it must operate; and owns the relationship with the regulator across all matters except specific operational regulatory reporting. The post\-holder must be willing and able to challenge their peers, including those above them, without flinching, and to escalate to the Board where necessary.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Designing the enterprise risk framework from a blank sheet: risk taxonomy, risk appetite, risk tolerances, key risk indicators, governance, and reporting
* Owning the day\-to\-day relationship with the regulator on all compliance and supervisory matters; leading the response to inspections and supervisory enquiries
* Owning the regulatory engagement plan: notifications, periodic submissions, supervisory meetings, thematic reviews, and ad hoc requests
* Providing second\-line oversight of adherence to CPMI\-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures; leading engagement with PFMI assessors and international supervisory bodies
* Designing and owning the financial crime framework: AML, counter\-terrorism financing, sanctions, and anti\-bribery and corruption; discharging or designating MLRO accountability
* Setting the information security policy framework and providing second\-line oversight of first\-line information security; owning regulator\-facing reporting on cyber matters
* Owning the policy framework: structure, hierarchy, ownership, review cycles, and attestation
* Providing independent second\-line reporting to the Board Risk Committee on risk, compliance, financial crime, and information security
* Line managing the Cybersecurity and Information Security Manager, KYC/Compliance Expert, and wider Risk and Compliance team as it builds



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 12 years in risk, compliance, or regulatory roles in financial services, with substantial time in a second\-line capacity at a regulated firm. Direct, demonstrable experience as the second\-line risk and compliance owner, or a senior member of the second\-line function, at a
 



 financial market infrastructure, custody bank, exchange, payment system, or major regulated financial institution: this is non\-negotiable.
 



  





 Direct experience engaging with a senior financial\-services regulator on licensing, supervisory matters, inspections, and policy development. Working knowledge of CPMI\-IOSCO Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures. Direct experience designing and operating an AML and financial crime framework, including MLRO accountability or close support of an MLRO. Track record of independently challenging first\-line decisions and escalating to Board level where necessary. Fluent in English.
 



  





 A professional qualification (ICA Diploma, CISI, ACAMS, or equivalent) is an advantage. So is familiarity with the IFC Oman regulatory framework, direct experience in a CSD, CCP, or exchange, and Arabic language skills.
 



  





**What this is** 




 The second\-line function does not exist yet. The risk framework has not been written, the compliance monitoring plan has not been set, and the regulatory relationship is in its earliest stages. The person who takes this role will build all of it and carry it through licensing and into operation. If you are unquestionably credible with senior regulators, have the independence to challenge upward when the evidence demands it, and want to build a second\-line function at a regulated FMI from a blank sheet, this is worth a conversation.

**Clinical Informatics \& Workflow Optimization** 




  




* Evaluate informatics solutions to ensure quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.
* Apply comprehensive testing methodologies to all clinical informatics interventions.
* Analyze current clinical and business processes and recommend workflow improvements.
* Document current\-state and future\-state workflows impacted by clinical documentation systems.
* Assess implementation strategies and evaluate their impact on clinical workflows and operations.
* Understand how system content and functionality affect clinical practice and operational workflows.



  





**Systems Implementation \& Support** 




  




* Support the implementation, optimization, and adoption of clinical systems and applications.
* Act as a key contact for clinical informatics\-related questions, issues, and troubleshooting.

**Data Analysis \& Governance** 




  




* Identify data issues and risks related to clinical informatics activities.
* Conduct higher\-level analysis and provide recommendations to stakeholders and governance bodies.
* Interpret healthcare legislation, industry trends, and emerging standards to support organizational practices.

**Training \& Stakeholder Engagement** 




  




* Support and participate in training activities for healthcare providers and trainers.

**Project Management \& Strategic Planning** 




  




* Lead and support large\-scale healthcare technology projects.
* Ensure project vision, direction, and deliverables align with organizational objectives.
* Utilize analytical models to evaluate solutions for business and information needs.
* Develop business plans including requirements analysis, solution alternatives, cost estimates, ROI analysis, implementation plans, and evaluation measures.
* Participate in strategic planning and priority\-setting activities considering budget and resource constraints.
* Prepare project status reports and related documentation.
* Perform other duties as assigned.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Clinical, Paramedical, Healthcare, or a related field.

* Strong understanding of clinical workflows and healthcare operations.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.
* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.

 The successful candidate will bring a clear point of view on the future state of enterprise technology, the right balance between in\-house capability and strategic partners, and the discipline to deliver value in quarters rather than years.

* Sit on the executive committee and act as a peer to the rest of the senior leadership.

The role carries the authority and the accountability to professionalize the digital operating model and to make the online business a genuine, profitable, and brand\-shaping pillar of the company.
   

  

 This is a building role. The product, marketing, fulfillment, and customer functions need to be brought together under one digital leader with the experience to deliver.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**
* Take full ownership of the digital P\&L, including revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, and operating profit across web, app, and any marketplace activity.

* Lead the technology choices that support the online business, in partnership with the broader technology function.
* Run the online trading operation, including range visibility, search relevance, recommendations, and promotional planning.
* Develop the marketplace and partner strategy where appropriate.
* Ensure the online proposition is coherent and commercially optimized.
* Own the digital customer P\&L, including acquisition, retention, lifetime value, and reactivation.
* Lead performance marketing, SEO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and loyalty.
* Build the data, personalization, and segmentation engine that turns a single view of the customer into measurable commercial impact.
* Lead the fulfillment and last\-mile strategy, including the right balance of own and third\-party logistics.
* Own the post\-purchase experience end to end, from order confirmation to delivery, returns, and after\-sales support.
* Set the standard for digital customer experience across all touchpoints.
* Sit on the executive committee as the voice of the customer and the online business.
* Represent the digital agenda to the Chief Executive Officer and the board.
* Build a digitally fluent, commercially disciplined team with strong representation of Saudi national talent.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Twelve to eighteen years in eCommerce, digital, or direct\-to\-consumer leadership, with at least five years owning a meaningful online P\&L.
* A demonstrable track record of taking a digital channel from low single\-digit to material double\-digit share of group revenue, profitably.
* Experience leading a digital function during a period of structural change, including operating model, talent, and platform decisions.
* Strong commercial instinct, comfortable owning gross margin, contribution margin, and operating profit, not only top\-line growth.
* Fluent in modern digital architecture, including headless commerce, composable platforms, search and personalization, app development, and CDP and CRM tooling.

Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **VP – Infrastructure, Cloud and Operations** 
 , reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. The role will lead enterprise\-wide infrastructure strategy, cloud transformation, and technology operations, ensuring a secure, scalable, and high\-performance digital foundation across Dubai Holding’s diverse portfolio.
 



  





 This is a critical leadership role driving the evolution of infrastructure from traditional operations to AI\-enabled, autonomous platforms, while ensuring strong commercial discipline, resilience, and service excellence.
 



  





 If you are ready to operate at the intersection of technology, business, and transformation, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Infrastructure Strategy \& Transformation** 



* Define and execute Dubai Holding’s enterprise infrastructure and cloud strategy aligned to business growth and digital ambitions
* Lead large\-scale transformation of legacy environments into modern, cloud\-native and hybrid platforms
* Establish governance frameworks, standards, and policies ensuring security, scalability, and operational consistency
* Drive resilience strategies including disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure risk management



**Cloud \& Platform Leadership** 



* Lead multi\-cloud and hybrid cloud strategy across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments
* Oversee cloud migration, optimization, and cloud\-native adoption across business units
* Implement infrastructure\-as\-code and automation frameworks to accelerate deployment and scalability
* Build strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and leading infrastructure providers



**Operations \& Service Excellence** 



* Own end\-to\-end IT infrastructure operations and service delivery across all business units
* Implement ITIL\-aligned service management practices, including incident, change, and problem management
* Ensure 24/7 monitoring, performance optimization, and uptime across critical systems
* Establish SLAs, KPIs, and continuous improvement frameworks for operational excellence



**Commercial \& Financial Leadership** 



* Own infrastructure P\&L including total cost of ownership across on\-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments
* Develop business cases for infrastructure investments, clearly articulating ROI and value realization
* Drive FinOps maturity, including cost transparency, showback/chargeback models, and cloud optimization strategies
* Lead negotiations with hyperscalers, telecom providers, and strategic vendors to optimize commercial outcomes
* Establish infrastructure unit economics (e.g., cost per workload, user, or transaction) to enable data\-driven decisions
* Partner with Finance and Procurement to ensure governance, cost control, and scalable investment planning



**Network, Data Center \& Connectivity** 



* Oversee infrastructure lifecycle across compute, storage, and networking environments
* Lead network strategy including LAN, WAN, and connectivity across multiple assets and locations
* Drive virtualization, containerization, and platform optimization initiatives
* Ensure robust infrastructure security and performance across all environments



**Agentic AI\-Ready Infrastructure** 



* Architect AI\-native infrastructure platforms supporting large\-scale deployment of AI agents and advanced workloads
* Lead transition toward autonomous operations, including self\-healing infrastructure and predictive operations
* Enable intelligent orchestration of infrastructure resources based on real\-time demand and business context
* Define strategy for GPU and compute environments supporting AI, LLMs, and advanced analytics workloads
* Establish governance, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop frameworks for AI\-driven infrastructure operations
* Drive cultural transformation toward AI\-enabled operations and reduced manual intervention



**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management** 



* Partner with executive leadership to align infrastructure investments with strategic priorities
* Manage vendor ecosystem including cloud providers, MSPs, and telecom partners
* Oversee contract negotiations, performance management, and vendor governance frameworks
* Ensure alignment with security, architecture, and governance functions across the enterprise



**Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* Build and lead high\-performing infrastructure, cloud, and operations teams
* Define organization structure and capability roadmap across infrastructure and cloud functions
* Drive talent development, certifications, and future skills in cloud, automation, and AI\-enabled operations
* Foster collaboration across IT and business units to deliver integrated technology services



  





**Who we are looking for** 



* 18\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud, and operations, with significant leadership exposure in complex enterprise environments
* Proven track record in leading large\-scale infrastructure and cloud transformations
* Strong experience managing multi\-vendor ecosystems and enterprise\-scale infrastructure platforms
* Deep expertise across data centers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and network environments
* Demonstrated experience in financial management of infrastructure, including cost optimization and vendor commercial strategies
* Experience operating at executive level, influencing senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams



  





**Education / Professional Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field required
* Master’s degree preferred
* Certifications in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) highly valued
* ITIL, infrastructure, or project management certifications advantageous



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Enterprise infrastructure architecture (compute, storage, networking, virtualization)
* Cloud computing platforms and hybrid/multi\-cloud strategies
* Infrastructure automation, orchestration, and IaC frameworks
* Network architecture, security, and performance management
* IT service management and ITIL practices
* Infrastructure financial management and cost optimization



  





**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking and transformation leadership
* Strong commercial and business acumen
* Executive stakeholder management and influence
* Problem solving and decision\-making in complex environments
* Ability to lead large, diverse technical teams



  





 As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.
 



  





 This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Manager, Data Domain and Products is accountable for governing, coordinating, and enabling a portfolio of data domains and their associated data products, rather than owning a single domain directly.
   

  

 The role ensures that domain data owners (Principal Specialists) operate within a consistent enterprise framework for data products, governance, quality, and value realization. It acts as the portfolio‑level authority, aligning domain priorities with enterprise strategy, resolving cross‑domain conflicts, and ensuring that data products are delivered as reusable, governed assets rather than siloed solutions.
   

  

 This role is responsible for how data domains operate together, how data products are prioritized and standardized, and how domain outputs collectively support enterprise reporting, operations, controls, and decision‑making.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide leadership and oversight across multiple data domains, each owned by a designated domain owner
* Ensure domain owners apply consistent principles for data ownership, stewardship, modeling, quality, and governance.
* Balance demand across domains by prioritizing data products based on enterprise value, regulatory need, and readiness.
* Ensure domain data products integrate cleanly with enterprise platforms and downstream consumers.
* Act as the primary business‑facing interface for enterprise data domains, translating strategic needs into coordinated domain roadmaps.
* Enable domain owners to focus on execution by removing blockers, resolving dependencies, and clarifying priorities.
* Ensure lifecycle artifacts (ownership, definitions, quality expectations, refresh SLAs) are consistently produced across domains.
* Lead and develop domain owners, ensuring clarity of role boundaries between domain ownership and enterprise oversight.

data.jd_text:
***About Odontyn***




 Odontyn is a market place and dental practice\-management platform used by clinics, dentists, and their patients. It covers clinical records, appointments, billing, imaging, telehealth, and integration with external health systems. The product is already in production, and we're actively building on it.
 



  





***The role***




 We're hiring one experienced full\-stack developer to own Odontyn outright: the Laravel
 



 backend, the React frontend, and the AWS infrastructure it runs on. You'd be the only developer on the product. You work directly with the founder, who sets product direction, but how the system is built and how it runs is yours to decide. It's a good fit if you've owned a production system on your own before. You should be steady at shipping, confident making technical decisions, and comfortable working without close oversight.
 



  





***Tech stack***



* **Backend:** 
  PHP 8\.3, Laravel 12, Filament v4, MySQL/MariaDB, Laravel Reverb (websockets)
* **Frontend:** 
  TypeScript, React 19, Vite, TanStack Router and Query, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
* **Infrastructure:** 
  AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, KMS), Stripe billing
* **Integrations:** 
  HL7 / NABIDH health\-system interoperability, real\-time updates, OpenAI, Deepgram, cloud.



  





***What you'll do***



* Maintain and extend the Laravel API (around 100 data models and 490 endpoints) and the role\-based React single\-page app.
* Build new features end to end, mostly small to medium, with some larger ones.
* Own the AWS side: deployments, EC2/RDS/S3, and setting up a proper CI/CD pipeline, since there isn't one yet.
* Keep production healthy: queue workers, websockets, billing, and monitoring.
* Improve test coverage and code quality as you go.
* Work closely with the founder on priorities and delivery.



  





***What we need***



* 5\+ years of professional full\-stack development experience.
* Strong PHP and Laravel: Eloquent, queues, events, and service\-layer architecture.
* Strong TypeScript and React with modern tooling (Vite, TanStack, component libraries).
* Solid REST API design and relational database skills (MySQL/MariaDB).
* Hands\-on AWS: comfortable owning EC2, RDS, and S3, and building deployment pipelines.
* Able to work independently and take full ownership of a live system.
* Good spoken English, and availability for regular calls and sync\-ups.



  





***Nice to have***



* Experience with the Filament admin framework.
* Healthcare interoperability (HL7, NABIDH) or other regulated\-industry experience.
* Privacy and compliance engineering: consent flows, audit trails, HIPAA or GDPR.
* Stripe billing and real\-time or websocket systems.
* Arabic or RTL internationalization.
* A strong testing habit, especially raising coverage on an under\-tested codebase.



  





***The details***



* Full\-time and fully remote.
* Start date: as soon as possible.
* Some overlap with Kuwait hours (GMT\+3\) is a plus; otherwise flexible, as long as you're reachable for regular calls.
* Compensation: 300–400 KWD per month, depending on experience
* Deadline to submit the application: 12th of June 2026 at 12pm
 
 (GMT\+3\).

**Job Description**
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The team**
 This group operates as a
 **startup within Careem** 
 with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a
 **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer \- WorkOS \- Enterprise Agentic AI** 
 to be the vanguard of the WorkOS mission. This is a role for a "heretic": someone who cares more about solving the problem and delivering value than following a rigid spec. You will be the bridge between our core AI engine and the messy, high\-stakes reality of our customers’ operations.
   

  

 As an FDE, you arent sitting in the back office; you are on the front lines, embedded with internal Careem verticals and external enterprise partners. In partnership with your implementation squad, consisting also of business transformation consultants, you will identify their deepest friction points and build the "special ops" code that proves the power of WorkOS. Your work is the proof of concept that will redefine how the region works.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Tip of the Spear: Lead the deployment of WorkOS in the field. You will be responsible for understanding a customers operational "chaos" and architecting an AI\-driven solution that fixes it in weeks, not months.
* Rapid\-Fire Execution: Build, iterate, and ship. You will write high\-quality, full\-stack code to create bespoke integrations and augment our platform’s core capabilities and create custom agents. This goes beyond context engineering; you’ll build the connective tissue \- integrating bespoke APIs, setting up RAGs and Evals, tuning the E2E system and performance, and architecting multi\-agent handoffs.
* Feedback Loop Mastery: You are the eyes and ears of the product team. You will translate field\-tested insights into core product requirements, ensuring WorkOS remains grounded in real\-world utility.
* Winning Stakeholders: Act as the technical face of WorkOS. You’ll need to win the trust of stakeholders, navigate complex enterprise hierarchies, and persuade skeptics by shipping results that speak for themselves.
* Technical Versatility: One day you’re setting up a RAG pipeline; the next, you’re debugging a legacy enterprise API or designing a custom dashboard. You do whatever is necessary to make the solution land.


**What You’ll Need**
* 5–8\+ years of high\-octane engineering experience. You are likely a senior\-level engineer who is "hungrier" than your peers and bored by traditional, slow\-moving dev cycles.
* The FDE Pedigree: Experience in forward\-deployed, mission\-driven environments (e.g., Palantir, high\-growth startups, or specialized consultancy) where you worked directly with customers.
* Full\-Stack Polyglot: Mastery of the modern stack (React/TS, Python/Node) with the ability to jump into any codebase and be productive on day one.
* AI Fluidity: Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks. You dont just know the theory; you know how to make AI work in production.
* Excellent Communication: You are a "social engineer." You can explain complex AI logic to a CEO and then pivot to a deep\-dive session with an infrastructure lead without missing a beat.
* Relentless Bias for Action: You are a builder who values shipping over perfection. You have a "founder\-level" sense of ownership and arent afraid to get your hands dirty.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, with occasional travel to be embedded with regional partners.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* A Special Ops Mission: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on winning the customer and solving "unsolvable" problems.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We Offer Colleagues The Opportunity To Drive Impact In The Region While They Learn And Grow. As a Full Time Careem Colleague, You Will Be Able To
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The team**
 This group operates as a
 **startup within Careem** 
 with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a
 **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer \- WorkOS \- Enterprise Agentic AI** 
 to be the vanguard of the WorkOS mission. This is a role for a "heretic": someone who cares more about solving the problem and delivering value than following a rigid spec. You will be the bridge between our core AI engine and the messy, high\-stakes reality of our customers’ operations.
   

  

 As an FDE, you aren't sitting in the back office; you are on the front lines, embedded with internal Careem verticals and external enterprise partners. In partnership with your implementation squad, consisting also of business transformation consultants, you will identify their deepest friction points and build the "special ops" code that proves the power of WorkOS. Your work is the proof of concept that will redefine how the region works.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Tip of the Spear: Lead the deployment of WorkOS in the field. You will be responsible for understanding a customer's operational "chaos" and architecting an AI\-driven solution that fixes it in weeks, not months.
* Rapid\-Fire Execution: Build, iterate, and ship. You will write high\-quality, full\-stack code to create bespoke integrations and augment our platform’s core capabilities and create custom agents. This goes beyond context engineering; you’ll build the connective tissue \- integrating bespoke APIs, setting up RAGs and Evals, tuning the E2E system and performance, and architecting multi\-agent handoffs.
* Feedback Loop Mastery: You are the eyes and ears of the product team. You will translate field\-tested insights into core product requirements, ensuring WorkOS remains grounded in real\-world utility.
* Winning Stakeholders: Act as the technical face of WorkOS. You’ll need to win the trust of stakeholders, navigate complex enterprise hierarchies, and persuade skeptics by shipping results that speak for themselves.
* Technical Versatility: One day you’re setting up a RAG pipeline; the next, you’re debugging a legacy enterprise API or designing a custom dashboard. You do whatever is necessary to make the solution land.


**What You’ll Need**
* 5–8\+ years of high\-octane engineering experience. You are likely a senior\-level engineer who is "hungrier" than your peers and bored by traditional, slow\-moving dev cycles.
* The FDE Pedigree: Experience in forward\-deployed, mission\-driven environments (e.g., Palantir, high\-growth startups, or specialized consultancy) where you worked directly with customers.
* Full\-Stack Polyglot: Mastery of the modern stack (React/TS, Python/Node) with the ability to jump into any codebase and be productive on day one.
* AI Fluidity: Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks. You don't just know the theory; you know how to make AI work in production.
* Excellent Communication: You are a "social engineer." You can explain complex AI logic to a CEO and then pivot to a deep\-dive session with an infrastructure lead without missing a beat.
* Relentless Bias for Action: You are a builder who values shipping over perfection. You have a "founder\-level" sense of ownership and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, with occasional travel to be embedded with regional partners.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* A Special Ops Mission: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on winning the customer and solving "unsolvable" problems.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.
